嗡——

大门剧烈震颤。

那块诡异的石芯瞬间化作一滩浓稠液体，如同拥有生命的藤蔓，沿着石头的纹理疯狂攀爬、流淌。

原本的墙在能量冲刷下，竟发出一阵令人牙酸的拔节声，表面渐渐泛起一层坚硬的金属光泽。

时间还在倒计时。

许默收回目光，转身走向远处的石壁。

指尖隔着缝隙，轻轻传递过去一道意念。

“这附近，有没有陌生人或者野狗靠近的痕迹。”

蚁后的情绪立刻顺着指尖爬入脑海。

没有。

许默紧绷的肩膀微微一松，随即又传递过去第二道指令。

“让工兵扩散出去，重点留意林子里那些孤零零的枯死大树，有情况立刻报备。”

做完这一切，许默将曜石战刃别在后腰。

“带上工具，去浆果丛。”

方芸默默抓起一把石斧，紧紧跟上。

两人一前一后，靴子踩在湿滑的腐叶上，发出黏腻的吧嗒声。

路过捕鸟筐的隐蔽点时，许默停下脚步。

四个捕鸟筐正在泥地里剧烈翻滚，里面传来绝望的沙哑嘶鸣。

四只渡鸦，不错。

但其中一只不知怎么搞的，身体被木片洞穿，此时已经是奄奄一息。

意念微动。

唰——

三只渡鸦连同捕鸟筐凭空消失。

储物面板的边角处，瞬间亮起几个带有动态锁链标识的微缩图。

活物竟能直接装进去。

许默眼底闪过异色，反手将地上的死鸟一并扔进空间。

这规则漏洞简直是意外之喜，天然的活体保鲜库。

收敛心神，两人马不停蹄地赶到那片隐蔽的浆果丛。

石锹深深楔入湿润的泥土，掀起夹杂着腐叶的腥气。

一场长达两个多小时的极限劳作。

许默拄着沾满泥浆的木柄，大口大口地吞咽着粗气。

酸痛感令他几乎无法直起腰。

在他脚边，直径超过一米的巨大土坨被完整剥离，粗壮的根系紧紧抓着泥壤。

他抬手抹去眼角的汗水，指尖触碰土坨。

光芒微闪，庞然大物收入囊中。

仅仅靠残破的树干稍作休整，许默再次转身，目光锁定枯树。

砰！砰！砰！

木材，石材。

在荒原，没有库存等于半条腿踏进棺材。

……

日头悄然偏斜。

Buzz——

The door shook violently.

The strange stone core instantly turned into a pool of thick liquid, like a living vine, climbing and flowing crazily along the texture of the stone.

The original wall made a heartbreaking sound as the energy washed away, and a layer of hard metallic luster gradually appeared on the surface.

The time is still counting down.

Xu Mo withdrew his gaze and turned towards the stone wall in the distance.

Through the gap, his fingertips gently conveyed a thought.

"Are there any signs of strangers or wild dogs approaching here?"

The Queen Ant's emotions immediately crawled down her fingertips into her mind.

No.

Xu Mo's tense shoulders relaxed slightly, and then he passed on the second instruction.

"Let the engineers spread out, pay special attention to the lonely dead trees in the forest, and report any situation immediately."

After doing all this, Xu Mo pinned the obsidian war blade on his back.

"Get your tools and go to the berry bushes."

Fang Yun silently grabbed a stone ax and followed closely.

The two walked one behind the other, their boots making a sticky clicking sound when they stepped on the slippery rotten leaves.

When passing by the hiding spot of the bird basket, Xu Mo stopped.

Four bird baskets were rolling violently in the mud, and a hoarse scream of despair could be heard from inside.

Four ravens, not bad.

But one of them didn't know what happened. His body was pierced by pieces of wood, and he was already dying.

Thoughts moved slightly.

Swish——

The three ravens and the bird basket disappeared out of thin air.

At the corners of the storage panel, several miniatures with dynamic chain logos lit up instantly.

Living things can be loaded directly into it.

A strange color flashed in Xu Mo's eyes, and he threw the dead birds on the ground into space with his backhand.

This loophole in the rules is an unexpected surprise, a natural living preservation store.

After gathering their minds, the two of them rushed to the hidden berry bush without stopping.

The stone shovel was wedged deeply into the moist soil, raising a fishy smell mixed with rotting leaves.

An extreme work lasting more than two hours.

Xu Mo leaned on the muddy wooden handle and swallowed heavily.

The soreness made it almost impossible for him to straighten up.

At his feet, a huge lump of soil with a diameter of more than one meter was completely peeled off, and its thick roots tightly grasped the soil.

He raised his hand to wipe the sweat from the corners of his eyes and touched the dirt with his fingertips.

The light flashed slightly, and the huge thing was put into the bag.

After resting on the broken tree trunk for a while, Xu Mo turned around again and fixed his gaze on the dead tree.

Bang!Bang!Bang!

wood, stone.

In the wilderness, no inventory means half a leg in the coffin.

…

The sun tilted quietly.
